title: PowerPoint on the web: reference an attached deck's style when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: Hold: the licensing field classifies this capability as an add-on even though the supporting documentation establishes only the surrounding Copilot experiences, not a separate entitlement for this option. The documented user workflow, licence-assignment controls and roadmap details are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published which licence experience specifically includes this attached-deck style option.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Copilot Agent Mode licensing prerequisites attached reference deck style; PowerPoint attached style license. Opened release notes, Copilot overview and license options; no option-specific entitlement found.

claims.claim: No meter or rate specific to this capability is published.

claims.claim: Assigning licences in the Microsoft 365 admin center requires at least a License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center licence control is at Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: go to the Users > Active users page. Select the row of the user ... In the right pane, select Licenses and Apps. Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph PowerShell assigns a user licence with Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @().
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: The Graph PowerShell licence-assignment route requires User.ReadWrite.All or another permission listed in the Assign license API reference.
claims.quote: Assigning and removing licenses for a user requires the User.ReadWrite.All permission scope or one of the other permissions listed in the 'Assign license' Microsoft Graph API reference page.

claims.claim: The row governs possession of a user licence rather than a dedicated setting for this style-reference option.
claims.quote: When you use the Active users page to assign or unassign licenses, you assign or unassign users licenses to products.

claims.claim: The entitlement model for this capability is add-on.
claims.quote: Searched: PowerPoint Copilot Agent Mode licensing prerequisites attached reference deck style. Opened release notes, Copilot overview and license options. Add-on describes the full product experience; no source establishes a separate add-on entitlement for this option.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to "included", the standard's model for a new option inside an already licensed product. Retain the notes describing Microsoft 365 Copilot Basic and the Microsoft 365 Copilot add-on full experience, and retain the qualification that the experience containing this specific option is not yet published. Do not assert that the option requires a separate add-on purchase. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/copilot-overview.
